## Equipment and model roles

Roles below are the actual records in this scenario. A shared family name does
not imply a calibrated device equation. Circuit roles describe resource bookkeeping;
energy roles describe declared supply/conversion/load relationships.

| Equipment ID and label | Symbol | Model / declared domains |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `supply` · Explicit electrical supply boundary | `transformer` | `processor`; energy: source |
| `breaker` · Batch cell electrical isolation | `breaker` | `valve`; energy: relay |
| `oven` · Electric rack / batch oven | `rack-oven` | `heater`; material: material (storage); air: air (passage); exhaust: air (passage); energy: load; retained heat |

## Editable assumptions

The complete scenario and per-component assumptions are in [model.json](model.json).
Reference provenance and authored-layout declarations are in [system.json](system.json).
Key scope statements from this model:

- All sources, sinks, and environmental inputs are explicitly declared. Model values are normalized indices, not plant operating predictions.
- The transformer symbol marks the explicitly declared electrical boundary; it does not simulate a utility grid or winding physics.
- The oven starts with a finite product batch; no continuously flowing production line is inferred from its resource ports.
- The heater accepts only electrical input and retains/cools stored heat after supply interruption. Door position is visual only; no interlock, convection or chemistry is modeled.

## Authored experiments

The [catalog entry](../index.json) stores each recipe, expected observation and
limitation. These are editable playground commands, not operating procedures.
Run or step the shared model to observe time-dependent effects.

| Experiment | Commands |
| --- | --- |
| Open the electrical breaker (`isolate-supply`) | `setOpen(equipment="breaker", value=true)` |
| Disable heating (`stop-heating`) | `setEnabled(equipment="oven", value=false)` |
| Fault the heating element (`element-fault`) | `setFault(equipment="oven", value="element-fault")` |
| Show a door seal leak (`seal-leak`) | `setFault(equipment="oven", value="door-seal-leak")` |
| Open the inspection door (`open-door`) | `setOpen(equipment="oven", value=true)` |
| Break the oven (`break-oven`) | `setDamage(equipment="oven", value=100)` |
